changes.comment: BREAKING: FileTreeMemoryStore.create takes scopeDecoding, the inverse of scopeEncoding, and refuses scopeEncoding without it. A vault written under a non-identity encoding now reopens: the open walk decodes each directory holding records and requires it to round-trip, and every read and write requires its encoded directory to be canonical and to decode back to the requested scope; a throwing coder becomes a failure. ISkippedRecord.scope is now optional (absent when a directory does not decode), and ISkippedRecord.path is the on-disk path
